brief.summary: Equities are softer: Nasdaq futures down about 0.6-0.7% and S&P slightly lower as AI/tech and IPO valuation concerns weigh. Treasuries are bid, with front-end and long-end yields lower and the curve flatter; oil is higher with Brent above $110 on Middle East risk, and AI-related credit spreads are widening. The Fed is framed as hawkish: October hike odds are low, but a December hike and possibly more are expected. The dominant narrative is an AI capex/valuation reset colliding with higher financing costs, partly offset by resilient earnings and a solid consumer. The tone is cautious and modestly risk-off.
notable_quotes: Tech leads rates, rates do not lead tech because tech is the engine of this economy right now.
Bonds have been responding to inflationary shocks, while the growth backdrop has been pretty solid.
